source: Kimi K2.7 Code PP13 qualification telemetry on 2026-06-13 plus first-three PP8 Qwen/Gemma measured per-layer memory from profiles/production/first3_resident_memory_budget.json.

resident_batch_token_budget.notes: Kimi2.7 stays at batch 16 with a 32768-token service gate while DSAPI admits up to 64 total completion-cohort items across the triad. The fixed 8 GiB Kimi and Qwen KV caps plus 6 GiB Gemma cap reserve just enough GPU KV for active and near-future JIT/cache batches instead of bloating resident KV.

kimi_batch16_fit_estimate.basis: Live Kimi2.7 PP13 direct/DSAPI runs completed with an 8 GiB fixed GPU KV cap, max_num_seqs=16, and max_num_batched_tokens=32768. The cap is intentionally small relative to the full resident capacity so LMCache/JIT can supply longer-lived prefixes from local storage.
kimi_batch16_fit_estimate.notes: This is an order-of-magnitude fit check, not a substitute for a relaunch. It says max_num_seqs=16 should fit comfortably with the fixed 8 GiB Kimi KV cap; the practical constraints are power and scheduler workspace.

projection.notes: Projection subtracts Qwen and Gemma model-layer estimates plus 2 GiB/node local CPU LMCache allowance from live Kimi-only MemAvailable. It does not count GPU-power margin; enforce power first through batch limits and service concurrency until a hardware power cap is proven.

power_policy.hardware_power_limit_status: No reliable per-Spark 150W NVML/powercap limit was exposed by nvidia-smi or /sys/class/powercap during the 2026-06-11 probe.
power_policy.initial_control: Use DSAPI service batch limits, token budgets, and one-running-batch-per-compute-domain admission until a hardware power cap is proven. Kimi batch 16 is a throughput target, not permission to saturate all three resident services at once.

promotion_gates: Kimi2.7 COMPSEC17 and 92-question runs stay within the accepted quality range for the smart lane.
Kimi2.7, Qwen27 PP13, and Gemma4 PP13 services are all launched from pulled main checkouts and pass DSAPI smoke through the triad topology.
LMCache canaries prove cache load/store does not change answers for each resident service.
Batch 16/32/16 throughput test keeps all active GPUs busy without resource-governor throttling.
